description:
Fetch the latest status/stage for a backtest by id. Response includes `stage` plus a rich `structuredContent.progress` snapshot of the current heartbeat:
  - `percent`, `eta`, `elapsed`, `simulationDate`, `portfolioValue`, `totalReturnPct`, `heartbeatElapsedSeconds`
  - `orders`: array of open/recent orders from the simulation's current iteration, sanitized to the same shape as
    `get_deployment_order_telemetry` — the 7 canonical fields (`timestamp`, `symbol`, `action`, `quantity`, `price`, `order_id`,
    `status`, `reason`) PLUS flat option/contract metadata (`asset_type`, `strike`, `expiration`, `option_type`,
    `order_type`) surfaced from the nested `asset` dict when the strategy trades options/futures so callers can
    render e.g. "SPY 2024-01-24 465 PUT smart_limit" without parsing OSI themselves. `null` if the heartbeat omits
    orders or the payload was malformed. Handles both live-listener `Order.to_dict()` and backtest-heartbeat
    `Order.to_minimal_dict()` shapes.
  - `positions`: array of current holdings sanitized to the same essential-fields shape as `get_deployment_position_telemetry`
    (`symbol`, `quantity`, `avg_fill_price`, `current_price`, `market_value`, `pnl`, `pnl_percent`, `asset_type`,
    `exchange`, `currency`, `multiplier`, `expiration`, `strike`, `option_type`, `underlying_symbol`, `asset`).
    Accepts both full `Position.to_dict()` and compact `Position.to_minimal_dict()` (`qty`/`val`/`pnl`) shapes.
  - `dataProvider`: the provider slug the backtest is routing through (e.g. `botspot_auto`, `ibkr`, `thetadata`) so
    you can confirm routing mid-run without waiting for `settings.json` at completion.
If you are monitoring, summarize those fields (progress + current results) instead of repeatedly polling.
After any slow or failed backtest, call once with includeTiming=true to see where the time went (`timing.run`, `timing.data.sharedCache`, `timing.strategy`) and, for failed runs, `failureSummary` (what failed and why, e.g. the asset, bar size and date of missing history). Numbers the run does not record are null and explained in `timing.missing`. For iteration counts and the slowest functions, rerun with start_backtest profile=true (profiling makes that run slower). To measure cold data speed, rerun with start_backtest cache="off".

backtestId.description: Actual backtest run UUID. Use the id returned by list_backtests or an explicit user-provided backtest id. Do not use a strategy id, aiStrategyId, revisionId, browser URL revisionId, conversation id, or a placeholder such as <unknown>.

includeTiming.description: Set true after a slow or failed backtest to get `timing`: where the run spent its time (waiting to start, startup, simulation seconds, simulated days per minute, end-of-run reports, upload), shared market-data cache hits, misses and bytes, and, for runs started with start_backtest profile=true, iteration counts and the slowest functions. Numbers a run does not record are null and listed in `timing.missing` with the reason. Reads a few small result files, so leave it off while polling.

name: backtest_status
title: Check backtest status
